svg.title: SG.12 What the Center Readout Shows
svg.desc: A Pixel 3 XL screenshot records the current main screen as a reference. The board defines how the center readout presents the selected location, temperature, matching typed weather symbol, supported sun and moon times, daily high and low, precipitation chance, and wind. It describes selected-hour, eligible carried-condition, and unavailable states while preserving selected-time authority and accessible condition text.
svg.text: SG.12 / WHAT THE CENTER READOUT SHOWS
Behavior board · owner approved 2026-11-05 · Pixel 3 XL main-screen reference captured 2026-11-05
CURRENT MAIN SCREEN
Installed baseline: DEMO DATA / REPLAY.
The screenshot records current UI; it is not
the approved SG.12 target composition.
Pixel 3 XL · 8AKY0M32X · 9:15 AM selected
READOUT CONTENT AND RESPONSIBILITY
The selected Instant controls every time-specific forecast fact and symbol.
Loaded location label + adjacent picker trigger
Label stays noninteractive; trigger opens the existing picker.
Temperature paired closely with the matching WA symbol
Identity comes from SG.11a–f's typed selected-time event.
Supported Sun/Moon rise and set times; daily high and low
Each supplied fact keeps its own unavailable behavior.
Precipitation chance and wind speed as prominent numbers
Compact cues flank the empty indicator-sized middle slot.
Selected day and time remain visible on the timeline.
No duplicate weekday/time line in the central readout.
Condition words remain available to accessible semantics and the forecast browser.
Visible center condition word is omitted; DEMO DATA and provenance remain.
SELECTED EVENT STATES
One selected time resolves to one state:
SUPPORTED SELECTED HOUR
Typed event → matching WA symbol
No visible condition word. Accessible
name agrees with the same event.
ELIGIBLE CARRIED CONDITION
Prior supplied symbol + source time
Disclose that selected-hour weather
is unavailable. Do not imply a new
condition was supplied for this hour.
NO SUPPORTED EVENT
Unavailable WA symbol/state
No clear-weather or other condition
claim is inferred.
Selected time, picker, and scale changes
cannot retarget the forecast instant.
SG.12 BOUNDARY
KEEP
Scene, source/provenance labels, timeline selection, selected-time authority, and readable accessible forecast meaning.
REMOVE
Visible center condition word and duplicate weekday/time line; lower magnifier and gear controls.
NO NEW
Event mapping, symbol artwork, provider endpoint, unit policy, or navigation behavior.
Companion visual target: SG.12-center-readout-ui-artwork-board.svg · boards guide scope; installed evidence establishes acceptance.
